name: elvish_archdruid_green_for_each_elf_you_control
notes: M7 mapper. Printed: 'Other Elf creatures you control get +1/+1. {T}: Add {G} for each Elf you control.' Seat 0 controls the Archdruid and two other Elves (1/1 each); seat 1 controls an Elf. The other Elves of seat 0 are 2/2, the Archdruid stays 2/2 and seat 1's Elf stays 1/1. Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). The Archdruid's tap makes {G}{G}{G}, three Elves (itself included, not seat 1's), and alone pays Eager Trufflesnout's {2}{G} with nothing left over.
